title: Easy Peanut Butter Pie
description: A simple and delicious peanut butter pie with a chocolate graham cracker crust, inspired by Mamaw Gail's recipe.

ingredients.item: Graham cracker pie crust (regular or chocolate)

steps: Put the vanilla pudding into a mixing bowl.
Add the cold milk to the pudding.
Mix for a couple of minutes until it thickens.
Add the peanut butter and mix well.
Pour the mixture into the graham cracker pie crust.
Refrigerate for two hours before serving.
notes:
For a richer flavor, use creamy peanut butter and add chocolate shavings on top before serving.

Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/v/1A2miTCVvQ/
